name: D3CISION
tagline: Turns thousands of security alerts into attack stories with a scored, explained priority for each.

awards: D3 Security - Sponsor Challenge // D3 Security - Défi commandité

problem: Security teams cannot investigate every alert and must choose with little context.
solution: Correlates events by entity and time into stories, scores threats with an XGBoost model on many features, and explains each score with SHAP.
demo_moment: Team-described: twenty related events collapse into one story with an explanation.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “D3 Security - Sponsor Challenge // D3 Security - Défi commandité” among 260 submissions.
Reports model quality (98.9% AUC) and explains every score.

lessons: Explain each score; a number without a reason does not help an analyst.
